method: Bounded local Go pprof -symbolize=none using existing six profile members; no binary download or network/source load.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Delivery/presence work remains blocked at capture.
hypotheses.result: Not supported by these sampled stacks: delivery workers wait at dequeue, lifecycle waits for workers; presence only tick/watch select. Cannot exclude prior stalls.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Heap allocation concentration identifies a bottleneck.
hypotheses.result: Concentration observed in Pebble, similar across services. Abnormality, CPU cost, allocation rate and causation are not established without baseline/delta/CPU profile.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The snapshots were taken after active workload paths became idle.
hypotheses.result: Supported for the named call paths at capture; not evidence of the earlier run interval.

limits: Profiles sampled roughly 12.4-13.1 minutes after the 17:06:50.121277292Z failure cut; service snapshots are not simultaneous.
No CPU, mutex or block profile, no heap before/after pair, no load-worker profile.
alloc_space is sampled cumulative allocation through collection, including startup/bootstrap/post-failure activity; not live bytes or allocation during the 61.212-second window.
inuse_space is sampled live Go-heap allocation, not total RSS, reserved heap or proof of machine headroom.
The archived goroutine snapshot can identify current stack locations, not waiting duration or earlier transient congestion.
No unique attribution of the 1 expired message or historical cloud failure; original product_failure/message_loss stays unchanged.
public_sanitization: Only counts, sizes, percent, times and function symbols; no raw profile, raw labels, addresses, identifiers or trace argument values.
local_observer_notes: Initial broad-focus no_samples heuristic treated tiny percentage formatting inconsistently; replaced before sealing by explicit row parsing: exactly two matching maintenance goroutines on all services.
One read-only rg lookup used presence_touch_worker.go and returned file-not-found; discovery identified the existing presence_touch.go. No tests or retries of workload occurred.
